FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 53
Committee: Children and Senior Advocacy Sponsor: Representative Rolanda Hollis
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/19/2026
House Bill 53 as introduced proposes a constitutional amendment, which if ratified, would
provide that the Legislature, by general law, to revive any time-barred right or remedy to sexual
abuse of a minor.
This bill would increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General
Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027.
